subject: util/collate, util/ranger: move and update `IsPadSpaceCollation()` (#56970)
summary: This commit moves PAD SPACE detection into `pkg/util/collate` and updates it so `utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci` and `utf8mb4_0900_bin` are treated as NO PAD (along with `binary`). Ranger’s LIKE planning/range-building (`pkg/util/ranger/checker.go`, `pkg/util/ranger/points.go`) now uses `collate.IsPadSpaceCollation()`, which changes whether a residual Selection is required and whether `_`-prefix ranges can safely exclude the prefix for `utf8mb4_0900_*` collations. Integration tests for LIKE range scans are updated (including new cases for `utf8mb4_0900_*` and switching `EXPLAIN` to `format = brief`). No later upstream/master changes indicate a follow-up fix for this logic.
